items.raw_excerpt: Portarlington has been crowned Victoria’s best small tourism town at this year’s Victorian Top Tourism Town Awards.
items.summary_en: Portarlington has won the title of Victoria's best small tourism town. It received the award at this year's Victorian Top Tourism Town Awards. It is a small seaside town on the Bellarine Peninsula.
items.summary_ko: 포틀링턴이 올해 빅토리아 주 관광 마을 시상식에서 주 최고의 소규모 관광 마을로 뽑혔습니다. 벨라린 반도의 작은 해변 마을 포틀링턴이 이번 수상으로 관광 명소로 주목받게 되었습니다.
items.title_en: Portarlington named Victoria's best small tourism town
items.title_ko: 포틀링턴, 빅토리아 최고 소규모 관광 마을로 선정

items.raw_excerpt: This is a very common French expression, but its meaning can be confusing for English speakers.
items.summary_en: Pas terrible is a very common French expression. But its meaning can be confusing for English speakers. It sounds like 'not terrible,' but it actually means 'not great' or 'just okay.'
items.summary_ko: 프랑스어 표현 '파 테리블'은 아주 흔하게 쓰이지만 영어 사용자에게는 뜻이 헷갈릴 수 있습니다. '끔찍하지 않다'처럼 들리지만, 실제로는 '별로다' 또는 '그저 그렇다'라는 뜻입니다.
items.title_en: French Expression of the Day: Pas terrible
items.title_original: French Expression of the Day: Pas terrible

items.raw_excerpt: Small in size, Switzerland is big on diversity. Here are nine maps that help you understand this curious country.
items.summary_en: Switzerland is a small country with a lot of variety. These nine maps show what makes it special.
items.summary_ko: 스위스는 작은 나라지만 다양성이 큽니다. 이 아홉 개의 지도는 스위스를 특별하게 만드는 점을 보여 줍니다.
items.title_original: The 9 essential maps you need to understand Switzerland

items.raw_excerpt: Ageing and housing are undeniably intertwined. A home can accompany us through every stage of life, from childhood and adulthood to old age, reflecting the concept of ageing in place — growing old in one’s own home or familiar community.
items.summary_en: A home can stay with us through every stage of life, from childhood to old age. This idea is called ageing in place, which means growing old in your own home or a familiar community.
items.summary_ko: 집은 어린 시절부터 노년까지 삶의 모든 단계를 함께할 수 있다. 이를 에이징 인 플레이스라고 하는데, 익숙한 집과 지역사회에서 나이 들어 가는 것을 뜻한다.
items.title_en: Ageing in place: A home that matches life's pace
items.title_ko: 내 집에서 나이 들기: 삶의 속도에 맞는 집
items.title_original: Ageing in place: A home that matches life’s pace

items.raw_excerpt: A rule that allows 14 and 15-year-olds to drink alcohol in Germany when supervised by an adult is set to be scrapped.
items.summary_en: Germany plans to remove a rule that lets 14 and 15-year-olds drink alcohol when an adult is present. The new rule means teenagers cannot drink alcohol even under adult supervision. The change was reported on August 13, 2026.
items.summary_ko: 독일에서 14~15세 청소년이 성인의 감독 아래 술을 마실 수 있게 한 규칙이 폐지될 예정입니다. 이 규칙이 없어지면 성인이 옆에 있어도 청소년은 술을 마실 수 없게 됩니다.
items.title_en: Germany to ban supervised drinking for teenagers
items.title_ko: 독일, 성인 동반 청소년 음주 규칙 폐지 예정
items.title_original: Germany to ban supervised drinking for teenagers

items.raw_excerpt: On beaches, mountains, parks and streets, tens of thousands of people in France turned their eyes to the sky on Wednesday to watch the solar eclipse - with long queues for glasses in the hours before the celestial events.
items.summary_en: Tens of thousands of people in France watched the solar eclipse from beaches, mountains, parks and streets on Wednesday. People queued for a long time to buy eclipse glasses in the hours before the event.
items.summary_ko: 수만 명의 프랑스 사람들이 수요일 해변과 산, 공원, 거리에서 하늘을 올려다보며 일식을 관람했다. 일식이 시작되기 몇 시간 전부터 관람용 안경을 사려는 긴 줄이 이어졌다.
items.title_en: Thousands across France line up to watch solar eclipse
items.title_ko: 프랑스 전역 일식 관람 열기, 안경 사려는 긴 줄까지
items.title_original: IN PICTURES: Thousands turn out in France to watch eclipse

items.raw_excerpt: Just two months after it was unveiled, the national youth care monument (Nationaal Monument Jeugdzorg) commemorating violence against young people in the system was vandalised in Apeldoorn. “This feels like a new attack,” Naomi van Aggelen told broadcaster NOS. She worked for years on the monument and was herself wrongly sent to live at a youth care institution when she was 12 years old. “It is a very sad sight,” she said of the monument meant to acknowledge the suffering...
items.summary_en: A monument for young victims of violence in the youth care system was vandalized in Apeldoorn. It was unveiled just two months ago. A woman who helped build it said it feels like a new attack.
items.summary_ko: 청소년 보호시설에서 겪은 폭력을 기억하기 위한 기념비가 아펠도른에서 훼손됐습니다. 이 기념비는 두 달 전에 공개된 지 얼마 안 됐습니다. 기념비를 만드는 데 참여한 한 여성은 새로운 공격 같다고 말했습니다.
items.title_en: Monument against youth care violence vandalized in Apeldoorn
items.title_original: Monument against violence in youth care system vandalized

items.raw_excerpt: An event in which public officials on Koh Phangan received shotguns as draw prizes will be the last of its kind, a senior Interior Ministry official said on Thursday.
items.summary_en: Officials on Koh Phangan island got shotguns as raffle prizes at an event. A senior ministry official said Thursday this will be the last time. The policy is now being changed.
items.summary_ko: 태국 코팡안 섬에서 열린 행사에서 공무원들이 경품으로 산탄총을 받는 일이 벌어졌다. 내무부 고위 관계자는 목요일 이런 경품 제공이 마지막이 될 것이라고 밝혔다. 관련 정책이 변경된다는 것이다.
items.title_en: Officials got shotguns as raffle prizes in Thailand

items.title_original: Gun prize giveaway prompts policy change

items.raw_excerpt: Spectacular images of lava flowing down the slopes of an erupting Mount Etna have drawn flocks of sometimes ill-equipped tourists to the Italian volcano – drawing concern from local guides.
items.summary_en: Spectacular images of flowing lava are drawing crowds to Mount Etna. Some tourists are not well equipped for the volcano. Local guides are worried about their safety.
items.summary_ko: 흘러내리는 용암의 장관을 찍은 사진들이 에트나 화산으로 관광객들을 끌어모으고 있다. 일부 관광객은 제대로 된 장비를 갖추지 못한 채 찾아오고 있다. 현지 가이드들은 이들의 안전을 걱정하고 있다.
items.title_en: Safety warnings as tourists rush to erupting Mount Etna

items.title_original: Safety warnings as tourists rush to Italy's erupting Mount Etna

items.raw_excerpt: Two pythons kept as pets in an apartment in Kawasaki City, Kanagawa Prefecture, have escaped, police said Thursday. According to police, a 19-year-old man called 110 at around 5 a.m. and said the two snakes had escaped from his third-floor apartment in Tama Ward, NTV reported. The snakes are a…
items.summary_en: Two pet pythons escaped from an apartment in Kawasaki City, Japan. A 19-year-old man called police at about 5 a.m. The snakes left his third-floor apartment in Tama Ward.

items.raw_excerpt: Days and daycares are getting hotter. And a growing number of parents, educators, and health and legal advocates are lobbying for maximum indoor temperature at daycares, likely 26 C, akin to standards adopted for long-term care facilities in Ontario.
items.summary_en: Some daycare rooms get very hot in summer. Many parents and experts want a rule that keeps indoor temperature at 26 C or lower. Ontario already has such a rule for nursing homes.
items.summary_ko: 여름에 일부 어린이집 보육실이 매우 더워집니다. 많은 부모와 전문가가 실내 온도를 26도 이하로 제한하는 규칙을 원합니다. 온타리오에는 이미 요양 시설에 그런 규칙이 있습니다.
items.title_en: Hot daycare rooms worry parents in Canada
items.title_original: Babies and toddlers are sweltering in some daycares. Should there be mandatory AC?

items.raw_excerpt: Tamil actor Arun Vijay has teamed up with filmmaker M Muthaiya for an upcoming rural drama titled Irulan, the makers announced on Wednesday
items.summary_en: Tamil actor Arun Vijay will work with filmmaker M Muthaiya on a new rural drama called Irulan. The makers shared the first look motion poster on Wednesday.
